"""Feedback control of the H1 using only the public robot client.
Every sent command and returned proprioception is saved for the record.
"""
import json,sys
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot
OUT=Path('/app/output'); OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
r=Robot(); spec=r.spec()
(OUT/'spec.json').write_text(json.dumps(spec,indent=2))
ranges=np.array(spec['action_types']['joint_position']['range_rad'])
def encode(q): return np.clip(2*(np.asarray(q)-ranges[:,0])/(ranges[:,1]-ranges[:,0])-1,-1,1)
def observe(): return r.get_obs(video='none')
def send(q,n=1,label='control'):
    a=encode(q)
    res=r.submit('joint_position',np.tile(a,(n,1)),cameras=['room_camera','left_eye_camera'],video='none')
    step=res.meta['control_steps']; res.save(OUT/'latest')
    with (OUT/'actions.jsonl').open('a') as f: f.write(json.dumps({'step':step,'n':n,'q':list(q),'a':a.tolist(),'label':label,'obs':res.meta['proprio']['now'],'done':res.done,'reason':res.meta['reason']})+'\n')
    print(step,np.round(res.meta['proprio']['now'][:10],3), 'imu',np.round(res.meta['proprio']['now'][38:],3),res.meta['reason'],flush=True)
    return res
if __name__=='__main__':
    if len(sys.argv)>1 and sys.argv[1]=='pose':
        q=np.zeros(19); q[[2,7]]=float(sys.argv[2]);q[[3,8]]=float(sys.argv[3]);q[[4,9]]=float(sys.argv[4]);send(q,int(sys.argv[5]),'pose')
    else:
        o=observe();o.save(OUT/'latest'); print(o.meta)
PY
